# Required wire presence

46 literal binary cases pin compatible-field presence separately from JSON named-key presence. They include the original four independent Required wire pins, scalar widening, incompatible scalar and collection kinds, zero-length inert collection bodies, compatible occurrences followed by skipped repeats, a wrong map-key kind, an unknown union arm, nested bodies/list/map/pointer refusal, the field after slot 512, the shared nested guard/negation/else corpus, and malformed text followed by a missing field (both diagnostics survive).

Hex bytes are fixed; tests do not regenerate them. Missing names and counters are explicit expectations checked by the neutral decoder and native Rust plain/retaining readers. The first four pins must also stay identical to the existing parent directory's binary files. Retaining refusals must clear every retained byte and id. Each occurrence is visited once; no pairwise cross-language matrix is needed.
